title: Rupee rebounds nearly 1% after RBI moves to curb speculative trades
summary: The rupee rebounded nearly 1% to 95.77 per dollar on Monday after the RBI announced measures to curb speculative currency trades. A special window for state-owned oil marketing companies eased spot-market pressure, though dollar buying by importers and corporates capped gains. Elevated crude prices and global uncertainties continue to weigh on the currency.

title: HCL Tech Q2 Report Card: Rupee boost, record deal wins, hiring rebound and AI boom despite odds - Key numbers decoded

title: Indian rice exporters find a way through disruptions to retain competitiveness in Gulf market
summary: Indian rice exporters have partnered with Eximwala Solutions to utilise bulk shipping for their products with an aim to significantly lower freight costs by about 74%, enhancing competitiveness. The shipments will mainly target the Gulf region, where demand for Basmati rice is substantial.
